title: APD run attempts
description: Per-run retry and repair counts in <run>/.apd-state/attempts.yaml: lens retries, first-pass schema failures, tier-gate failures, report-audit iterations and the tier repair loop. Written at closeout by `apd-gauntlet summarize --record-attempts` (or a runner's write_attempts); compare-runs reads it for the first-pass and audit gates. Runs from 1.7 have no such file.

recorded_by.description: Who wrote the file: the Claude Code workflow, a local runner, or an operator by hand.

lens_retries.description: Retries per lens: lens name -> re-dispatches after its first attempt.

first_pass_invalid.description: Lenses whose first receipt was an error or listed an output that failed schema validation.

tier_gate_failures.description: Tier directories whose first tier gate failed, before any repair.

skipped.description: Lenses whose receipt listed a .skipped output (for example on a resumed run).

audit_iterations.description: Report-audit attempts the run made, the last one included.

tier_repairs.description: Files the tier repair loop repaired: tier directory -> files.

lens_reruns.description: Lenses the tier repair loop re-ran: lens name -> re-runs.
